en: The image shows the written/mailed side of an old postcard. There is a green 5‑Heller Austro‑Hungarian stamp with the portrait of Emperor Franz Joseph I in the upper‑right corner and a circular cancellation mark. The card is filled with cursive handwriting in Italian, including an address on the right side and a message on the left. Some lines are crossed out in pencil. A vertical printed line in the center reads "THEODOR EISMAN LEIPZIG." The address includes the city name "Fiume" and the word "Ungheria" (Hungary).
